description:
Advances: specled.package, specled.branch_guard

Scope expansion carved from specled_-q0q.2 grader findings: the S2 merge added an eleventh append_only finding code and superseded the v1 budget ADR, leaving three stale statements S3 cannot fix (lib is out of scope there). Full contract in the first comment on this ticket.

comments.text:
CONTRACT (orchestrator-authored; treat as the ticket body)

Deliverable:
1. docs/concepts.md:491 — the sentence stating the append-only finding set "is budgeted (ten codes — see specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget)" is now false. Update to eleven codes and reference specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget_v2 (the v1 ADR is superseded).
2. lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex:25 — comment still says "append_only/* (10 ratified codes)"; update the count.
3. lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex @per_code_defaults — add the "append_only/self_authorized_weakening" => :info entry so the map matches the mirror role the docs lint comment (test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:79) ascribes to it. Behavior-identical: render_findings/2 already falls back to the builder severity.

Spec co-change is AUTHORIZED where the gate forces it: the smallest edits to .spec/specs/package.spec.md / branch_guard.spec.md / implementation_tier.spec.md that keep branch_guard_missing_subject_update green, and .spec/realization_hashes.json refresh if the branch_check.ex touch drifts a named binding.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs; any package.spec doc verification commands touching docs/concepts.md
- Iteration tier: targeted files + mix spec.check --no-run-commands
- Final tier: bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh run-until-green, plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref

Allowed touches:
- docs/concepts.md
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex (the line-25 comment and the @per_code_defaults map entry ONLY)
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md, .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md, .spec/specs/implementation_tier.spec.md (gate-forced minimal co-change only)
- .spec/realization_hashes.json (binding refresh only if forced)
- test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs (only if a gate mechanically forces it; none expected)

Out of Scope (files): VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex, lib/specled_ex/overlap.ex, .spec/decisions/**
Out of Scope (intent): no behavior change anywhere — the @per_code_defaults entry must be behavior-identical (:info matches the builder); no rewrites of existing spec statements; no other doc edits.

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors; targeted tests; bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

title: S2.b: post-merge staleness sweep — docs code-count + branch_check mirror
